mini_task_spec:
In the NestJS monorepo at `test-repo/`, the directory `test-repo/packages/common/exceptions/` contains individual TypeScript files for each HTTP exception class. Each exception file (named `*.exception.ts`) references a specific HTTP status code via `HttpStatus.<CONSTANT>`. The HTTP status code values are defined in `test-repo/packages/common/enums/http-status.enum.ts`.

**Task**: Identify all `.exception.ts` files in `test-repo/packages/common/exceptions/` whose HTTP status code falls in the 5xx range (500–599 inclusive). Return the base file names only (no directory paths), sorted alphabetically, one per line.

The expected answer format is a list of file names (e.g., `bad-gateway.exception.ts`), one per line, sorted alphabetically.
